description: This file implements a lockfile utility for managing file locks, including acquiring, releasing, and updating locks with support for stale lock detection and retries. It is part of a third-party utility library used within the project.

methods.name: probe
methods.description: Probes the lockfile to determine its modification time and precision, caching the result.

methods.name: getMtime
methods.description: Returns the current time adjusted to the specified precision ('s' or 'ms').

methods.name: getLockFile
methods.description: Generates the lockfile path based on the filename and options.

methods.name: resolveCanonicalPath
methods.description: Resolves the canonical path of a file, optionally following symlinks.

methods.name: acquireLock
methods.description: Attempts to create a lockfile atomically and handles stale lock detection.

methods.name: isLockStale
methods.description: Checks if a lock is stale based on its modification time.

methods.name: removeLock
methods.description: Removes the lockfile, ignoring errors if it does not exist.

methods.name: updateLock
methods.description: Periodically updates the lockfile's mtime to keep the lock active.

methods.name: setLockAsCompromised
methods.description: Marks a lock as compromised and triggers the onCompromised callback.

methods.name: lock
methods.description: Main function to acquire a lock on a file with retries and options.

methods.name: unlock
methods.description: Releases a lock on a file.

methods.name: ensureCleanup
methods.description: Sets up cleanup to release locks on process exit.
